title: A crowd of buckets
summary: One bucket is vague. The crowd’s vote can be sharp.

cards.text:
One bucket likes many directions.
Its water level alone is not a compass.

Each bucket votes for its favorite direction,
as hard as it is currently tipping.

question.prompt: Equal votes for left and for up point which way?
question.why: Equal pulls land on the diagonal.
question.simpler: Add the two directions. Do not pick a winner.

recall.question: One broadly tuned bucket, or the crowd: which one carries the direction?

deeper.note: Georgopoulos, Schwartz, and Kettner watched motor cortex do this. The population vector is the vote.

paper.title: Neuronal population coding of movement direction
paper.section: The vector hypothesis and the figure beside the movement.

terms.definition: A representation carried by the pattern across neurons, not by any single one.
